preconditions.description: The length of the array is between 1 and 1000.
Each element of the array is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of pairs is either -1 (indicating no such list exists) or a non-negative integer up to n(n-1)/2.

postconditions.expression: all(u_i < v_i for u_i, v_i in pairs) and all((a[u_i] > a[v_i]) == True for u_i, v_i in pairs)
postconditions.description: All pairs are distinct and form an inversion in the array.

postconditions.expression: all(a[u_i] <= a[v_i] for u_i, v_i in pairs) or m == 0
postconditions.description: After processing all pairs in the list, the array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
